data.one_liner: Dart wrapper for libsignal providing Signal Protocol end-to-end encryption.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart and Flutter bindings for libsignal, implementing the Signal Protocol for end-to-end encryption, sealed sender, group messaging, and cryptographic operations. It bridges native Rust code directly via Flutter Rust Bridge.
use_when: You need Signal Protocol end-to-end encryption in a Dart or Flutter application.
You require secure group messaging or anonymous sealed sender features.
avoid_when: You only need basic hashing or standard TLS encryption without the Signal Protocol.
Your project cannot use AGPL-3.0 licensed dependencies.
strengths: Direct native Rust integration via Flutter Rust Bridge for high performance.
Comprehensive implementation of the Signal Protocol including Double Ratchet and X3DH.
weaknesses: Strict AGPL-3.0 license may restrict commercial usage depending on distribution.
Certain native features like registration and server-side backup are not implemented.
data.setup_notes: Native libraries are downloaded automatically during build via Dart build hooks. No manual Rust toolchain is required for end users.
